## Investigation Report

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Verdict | CONFIRMED |
| Confidence | HIGH |
| Severity | MEDIUM |
| Task Type | Workflow correctness remediation |
| Complexity | STANDARD |

### Claimed Behavior

A successful merge can remain projected as `workflow:awaiting-merge` when post-merge bookkeeping or terminal work fails before the merged label is applied.

### Observed Behavior

The current integration source confirms the ordering hazard. In `#finalize`, `mergePullRequest` returns before `appendEffect`, merge `phase.completed`, and the first `workflow:merged` projection. In `#runParentNode`, the merge effect is recorded before the merged projection, and later node completion/post-merge work can still fail before the terminal projection. Direct terminal recovery projects `workflow:merged` only after branch/worktree cleanup and terminal journal work. The existing tests assert label mapping and adapter idempotency, but not that a successful merge projects the merged stage before subsequent bookkeeping.

### Root Cause

Merge success and merged-label projection are not treated as one ordered completion boundary. The implementation performs durable effect/phase bookkeeping and, in recovery, destructive terminal work before requesting the merged projection. Any exception in that intervening work can leave the external issue label at `workflow:awaiting-merge`, while the pull request is already merged and the completion callback marks the run failed instead of retrying the missing label.

### Affected Files

| Path | Reason |
| --- | --- |
| `src/workflows/work-on.ts` | Reorder successful-merge projection ahead of merge bookkeeping and terminal post-merge work in direct, parent-node, and direct-recovery paths. |
| `test/workflows/work-on.test.ts` | Add focused regression coverage for merge → merged-label projection → bookkeeping ordering. |

### Evidence

- `src/workflows/work-on.ts` direct finalization currently calls `appendEffect` and merge `phase.completed` before `#projectWorkflowStage(link, "merged", ...)`.
- `src/workflows/work-on.ts` parent merge handling records the merge effect before its first merged-stage projection and performs additional review/node artifacts afterward.
- `src/workflows/work-on.ts` direct terminal recovery performs branch/worktree cleanup and terminal journal operations before its merged-stage projection.
- `#projectWorkflowStage` retries a projection but ultimately warns and returns; it cannot protect a later post-merge operation that throws before a deferred projection.
- `test/workflows/work-on.test.ts` covers `workflowLabelForNode("merge", "merged")`, while `test/adapters/github-projection.test.ts` covers repeated label writes; neither verifies ordering around a successful merge.

### History

- Issue #119 is the remediation issue generated from finding `workflow-correctness-001` on PR #117.
- The finding cites original issue #92 and identifies the merge API, durable bookkeeping, and delayed projection as the failure window.
- `CHANGELOG.md` contains no separate issue-specific entry; the supplied PR-review finding is the available historical record.

### Recommendation

Introduce one small merge-completion sequencing helper used by the direct finalizer and parent merge node so a successful merge invokes the merged projection before effect/phase bookkeeping and later post-merge work. Move direct terminal-recovery projection immediately after the verified merged pull read-back. Keep the existing idempotent later reconciliation behavior and add a focused ordering regression test.

### Related Issues

- #92
- #117

**Required**: no — this is one bounded workflow-ordering defect with one production file and one focused test file.
